		game._physics_process(1.0 / 60)
		Contact.Pose.present(game, 1)
		_sample()


## Задаёт удерживаемые направления штатному движку движения и коллизий.
func _keys(direction: Vector2) -> void:
	game.move_left_held = direction.x < 0
	game.move_right_held = direction.x > 0
	game.move_up_held = direction.y < 0
	game.move_down_held = direction.y > 0


## Независимо пересчитывает поле и экспоненту, записывая все промежуточные отсчёты, включая не снятые в PNG.
func _sample(reset: bool = false) -> void:
	game.camera_offset = Vector2(-8000, -8000) if mode == "offscreen" else Vector2(1464, 378)
	Wind.WorldProjection.sync_background(game)
	var owner := game.get_node_or_null(Wind.NAME)
	if reset:
		if owner != null:
			owner.recovery.clear()
		oracle = Contact.empty()
		oracle_seconds = -1
		oracle_player = Vector2.INF
	Wind.update(game)
	owner = game.get_node(Wind.NAME)
	var seconds := Wind.Clock.seconds(game)
	var desired := Contact.empty()
	var valid := Wind.allowed(game) and not Contact.Frame.read(game).is_empty()
	var motion: Dictionary = game.get_meta(Contact.Speed.META, {})
	desired = _reference_target(valid, motion, seconds)
	_advance_reference(valid, desired, seconds, owner)
	for i in 64:
		if expected[i].distance_to(owner.render_contacts[i]) > 0.00001:
			errors.append("oracle mismatch %d:%d" % [audit.size(), i])
	_record_sample(reset, valid, desired, seconds, owner, motion)


## Вычисляет поле только из стоп героя, опор и фактически разрешённого движения.
func _reference_target(valid: bool, motion: Dictionary, seconds: float) -> PackedVector2Array:
	var desired := Contact.empty()
	var gain := 1.0
	if (
		not motion.is_empty()
		and motion.player == game.player
		and motion.seconds == seconds
		and motion.world == game.current_location
	):
		gain += (
			0.9
			* pow(
				minf(
					(
						(Vector2(motion.player) - Vector2(motion.origin)).length()
						/ float(motion.delta)
						/ 280.0
					),
					1.0
				),
				2
			)
		)
	if valid:
		for i in Wind.placements().size():
			var offset := (Contact.Pose.ground(game) - Vector2(Wind.placements()[i].anchor)) / 36.0
			var square := offset.dot(offset)
			if square < 1:
				desired[i] = -offset * 8.0 * pow(1.0 - square, 2) * gain
	return desired


## Независимо интегрирует экспоненту, включая точный ноль и очистку невидимых опор.
func _advance_reference(
	valid: bool, desired: PackedVector2Array, seconds: float, owner: Node
) -> void:
	var flag: Variant = game.get_meta(Recovery.FLAG, true)
	var disabled: bool = typeof(flag) != TYPE_BOOL or not flag
	var elapsed := maxf(0, seconds - oracle_seconds) if oracle_seconds >= 0 else 0.0
	var jump := (
		oracle_player.is_finite()
		and Vector2(game.player).distance_to(oracle_player) > maxf(8, 720 * elapsed)
	)
	if not valid or disabled or seconds < oracle_seconds or jump:
		oracle = Contact.empty()
		oracle_seconds = -1
		oracle_player = Vector2.INF
		elapsed = 0
	if valid and not disabled:
		for i in 64:
			if i not in owner.visible_rows:
				oracle[i] = Vector2.ZERO
				continue
			var tau := 0.18 if desired[i].length_squared() < oracle[i].length_squared() else 0.08
			if elapsed > 0:
				oracle[i] = desired[i] + (oracle[i] - desired[i]) * exp(-elapsed / tau)
			if desired[i] == Vector2.ZERO and oracle[i].length() <= 0.005:
				oracle[i] = Vector2.ZERO
		oracle_seconds = seconds
		oracle_player = game.player
	expected = desired.duplicate() if valid and disabled else oracle.duplicate()


## Записывает также внутреннюю память: нулевой вывод сам по себе ещё не доказывает корректный следующий шаг.
func _record_sample(
	reset: bool,
	valid: bool,
	desired: PackedVector2Array,
	seconds: float,
	owner: Node,
	motion: Dictionary
) -> void:
	var flag: Variant = game.get_meta(Recovery.FLAG, true)
	var raw := []
	var actual := []
	var filtered := []
	var stored := []
	var seed := []
	for i in 8:
		raw.append(Points.pair(desired[i]))
		actual.append(Points.pair(owner.render_contacts[i]))
		filtered.append(Points.pair(expected[i]))
		stored.append(Points.pair(owner.recovery.entries.get(i, Vector2.ZERO)))
		if pending_seed != Contact.empty():
			seed.append(Points.pair(pending_seed[i]))
	var step := {}
	if not motion.is_empty():
		step = {
			"origin": Points.pair(motion.origin),
			"player": Points.pair(motion.player),
			"delta": motion.delta,
			"world": motion.world,
			"seconds": motion.seconds,
			"velocity": Points.pair(motion.velocity)
		}
	audit.append(
		{
			"reset": reset,
			"valid": valid,
			"seconds": seconds,
			"player": Points.pair(game.player),
			"presented": Points.pair(Contact.Pose.ground(game)),
			"world": game.current_location,
			"mode": mode,
			"flag": flag,
			"visible": owner.visible_rows.duplicate(),
			"seed": seed,
			"stored": stored,
			"raw": raw,
			"actual": actual,
			"expected": filtered,
			"active": owner.recovery.entries.size(),
			"motion": step
		}
	)

	pending_seed = Contact.empty()


## Сравнивает фильтр и технический откат при одном состоянии; после пары возвращает точное исходное состояние фильтра.
func _case(id: String, seconds: float) -> void:
	var owner := game.get_node(Wind.NAME)
	var folder := output.path_join(id)
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(folder)
	_prepare_cpu_meshes(owner, seconds)
	var state := [
		owner.recovery.entries.duplicate(),
		owner.recovery.last_seconds,
		owner.recovery.last_player,
		owner.recovery.last_world
	]
	var original: Variant = game.get_meta(Recovery.FLAG, true)
	var text := JSON.stringify(game.SaveSystem.snapshot(game))
	var si := snapshots.find(text)
	if si < 0:
		si = snapshots.size()
		snapshots.append(text)
	var variants := []
	for active in [true] if mode == "pause" else [true, false]:
		variants.append(await _capture_variant(owner, folder, original, active))

	reference.get_texture().get_image().save_png(folder.path_join("reference.png"))
	var background: Node2D = game.get_node("WorldBackground")
	rows.append(
		{
			"id": id,
			"sample": audit.size() - 1,
			"seconds": seconds,
			"mode": mode,
			"world": game.current_location,
			"player": Points.pair(game.player),
			"camera": Points.pair(game.camera_offset),
			"background":
			{"position": Points.pair(background.position), "scale": Points.pair(background.scale)},
			"snapshot": si,
			"snapshot_sha": text.sha256_text(),
			"window": Points.pair(DisplayServer.window_get_size()),
			"logical": Points.pair(root.get_visible_rect().size),
			"target": Points.pair(owner.batch.viewport.size),
			"visible": root.visible,
			"focused": DisplayServer.window_is_focused(),
			"variants": variants
		}
	)
	game.set_meta(Recovery.FLAG, original)
	owner.recovery.entries = state[0]
	owner.recovery.last_seconds = state[1]
	owner.recovery.last_player = state[2]
	owner.recovery.last_world = state[3]
	Wind.update(game)
	if not root.visible or Points.pair(DisplayServer.window_get_size()) != Points.pair(size):
		errors.append(id + ": invalid window")


## Снимает один вариант и возвращает его паспорт независимо от того, включён фильтр или выключен.
func _capture_variant(owner: Node, folder: String, original: Variant, active: bool) -> Dictionary:
	game.set_meta(Recovery.FLAG, original if active else false)
	Wind.update(game)
	callbacks.clear()
	game.draw_records.clear()
	game.observe_draw = true
	var stats := Wind.statistics(game)
	for frame in 2:
		for group in owner.batch.groups:
			group.queue_redraw()
		game.queue_redraw()
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	game.observe_draw = false
	var label := "on" if active else "off"
	owner.batch.viewport.get_texture().get_image().save_png(folder.path_join(label + ".png"))
	if active:
		root.get_texture().get_image().save_png(folder.path_join("window.png"))
	return {
		"active": active,
		"flag": game.get_meta(Recovery.FLAG),
		"stats": stats,
		"callbacks": callbacks.duplicate(true),
		"draws": _draw_records(),
		"after_sha": JSON.stringify(game.SaveSystem.snapshot(game)).sha256_text()
	}


## Строит независимый CPU-эталон из исходных UV, неподвижной нижней полосы и записанного изгиба.
func _prepare_cpu_meshes(owner: Node, seconds: float) -> void:
	for i in reference_nodes.size():
		var row: Dictionary = owner.batch.rows[i]
		var passport := Wind.Roots.profile(row.kind)
		var data := UV.mesh_data(row.kind, 72.0 / passport.size.x)
		var phase: float = stored_phases[i]
		var amount := (
			Vector2(
				(
					1.35
					* (
						0.78 * sin(seconds * 0.95 + phase)
						+ 0.22 * sin(seconds * 1.61 + phase * 1.7)
					)
				),
				0
			)
			+ expected[i]
		)
		var points: PackedVector2Array = data.arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
		var coords: PackedVector2Array = data.arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV]
		for v in points.size():
			points[v] += (
				amount
				* pow(
					clampf(
						(
							(float(passport.lock_y) / passport.size.y - coords[v].y)
							/ (float(passport.lock_y - passport.top) / passport.size.y)
						),
						0,
						1
					),
					2
				)
			)
		data.arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = points
		reference_nodes[i].mesh = UV.make_mesh(data)
	reference.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE


## Упаковывает фактические обратные вызовы игры, сохраняя снимки до и после рисования.
func _draw_records() -> Array:
	var draws := []
	for r in game.draw_records:
		draws.append(
			{
				"before_sha": JSON.stringify(r.before).sha256_text(),
				"after_sha": JSON.stringify(r.after).sha256_text(),
				"equal": r.equal,
				"geometry_equal": r.geometry_equal,
				"frame": r.process_frame
			}
		)
	return draws

		mode = "teleport"
		_sample()
		await _case("teleport-" + target, Wind.Clock.seconds(game))
		rows.back().teleport_success = success
		if not success:
			errors.append("QA transfer failed")


## Сохраняет полный след, версии протокола и честные границы нативного прогона.
func _write_capture() -> void:
	var anchors := []
	for row in Wind.placements():
		anchors.append(Points.pair(row.anchor))
	FileAccess.open(output.path_join("capture.json"), FileAccess.WRITE).store_string(
		(
			JSON.stringify(
				{
					"task": "VFOLIAGE-006",
					"review_revision": REVIEW_REVISION,
					"profile": profile,
					"display": DisplayServer.get_name(),
					"seed": game.world_loot_seed,
					"anchors": anchors,
					"rows": rows,
					"audit": audit,
					"snapshots": snapshots,
					"errors": errors,
					"hardware_input_accepted": false,
					"performance_eligible": false
				}
			)
			+ "\n"
		)
	)
	print("RECOVERY NATIVE: ", rows.size(), " cases; ", errors)
	quit(0 if errors.is_empty() else 2)


## Готовит контакт остановившегося героя; исходная позиция и сброс принадлежат только QA-фикстуре.
func _prime() -> void:
	mode = "normal"
	game.menu_state.pause_open = false
	game.current_location = "overworld"
	game.settings_state.reduced_motion = false
	game.set_meta(Wind.QUALITY, "normal")
	game.set_meta(Recovery.FLAG, true)
	preload("res://scripts/presentation/visual_reference_mode.gd").disable(game)
	game.player = Wind.placements()[6].anchor - Vector2(16, 0)
	game.speed = 210
	game.speed_timer = 0
	game.clear_movement_keys()
	Contact.Pose.reset(game)
	Contact.Frame.publish(game, 1.0 / 60)
	_sample(true)
	for i in 12:
		game._physics_process(1.0 / 60)
		Contact.Pose.present(game, 1)
		_sample()


## Задаёт удерживаемые направления штатному движку движения и коллизий.
func _keys(direction: Vector2) -> void:
	game.move_left_held = direction.x < 0
	game.move_right_held = direction.x > 0
	game.move_up_held = direction.y < 0
	game.move_down_held = direction.y > 0


## Независимо пересчитывает поле и экспоненту, записывая все промежуточные отсчёты, включая не снятые в PNG.
func _sample(reset: bool = false) -> void:
	game.camera_offset = Vector2(-8000, -8000) if mode == "offscreen" else Vector2(1464, 378)
	Wind.WorldProjection.sync_background(game)
	var owner := game.get_node_or_null(Wind.NAME)
	if reset:
		if owner != null:
			owner.recovery.clear()
		oracle = Contact.empty()
		oracle_seconds = -1
		oracle_player = Vector2.INF
	Wind.update(game)
	owner = game.get_node(Wind.NAME)
	var seconds := Wind.Clock.seconds(game)
	var desired := Contact.empty()
	var valid := Wind.allowed(game) and not Contact.Frame.read(game).is_empty()
	var motion: Dictionary = game.get_meta(Contact.Speed.META, {})
	desired = _reference_target(valid, motion, seconds)
	_advance_reference(valid, desired, seconds, owner)
	for i in 64:
		if expected[i].distance_to(owner.render_contacts[i]) > 0.00001:
			errors.append("oracle mismatch %d:%d" % [audit.size(), i])
	_record_sample(reset, valid, desired, seconds, owner, motion)


## Вычисляет поле только из стоп героя, опор и фактически разрешённого движения.
func _reference_target(valid: bool, motion: Dictionary, seconds: float) -> PackedVector2Array:
	var desired := Contact.empty()
	var gain := 1.0
	if (
		not motion.is_empty()
		and motion.player == game.player
		and motion.seconds == seconds
		and motion.world == game.current_location
	):
		gain += (
			0.9
			* pow(
				minf(
					(
						(Vector2(motion.player) - Vector2(motion.origin)).length()
						/ float(motion.delta)
						/ 280.0
					),
					1.0
				),
				2
			)
		)
	if valid:
		for i in Wind.placements().size():
			var offset := (Contact.Pose.ground(game) - Vector2(Wind.placements()[i].anchor)) / 36.0
			var square := offset.dot(offset)
			if square < 1:
				desired[i] = -offset * 8.0 * pow(1.0 - square, 2) * gain
	return desired


## Независимо интегрирует экспоненту, включая точный ноль и очистку невидимых опор.
func _advance_reference(
	valid: bool, desired: PackedVector2Array, seconds: float, owner: Node
) -> void:
	var flag: Variant = game.get_meta(Recovery.FLAG, true)
	var disabled: bool = typeof(flag) != TYPE_BOOL or not flag
	var elapsed := maxf(0, seconds - oracle_seconds) if oracle_seconds >= 0 else 0.0
	var jump := (
		oracle_player.is_finite()
		and Vector2(game.player).distance_to(oracle_player) > maxf(8, 720 * elapsed)
	)
	if not valid or disabled or seconds < oracle_seconds or jump:
		oracle = Contact.empty()
		oracle_seconds = -1
		oracle_player = Vector2.INF
		elapsed = 0
	if valid and not disabled:
		for i in 64:
			if i not in owner.visible_rows:
				oracle[i] = Vector2.ZERO
				continue
			var tau := 0.18 if desired[i].length_squared() < oracle[i].length_squared() else 0.08
			if elapsed > 0:
				oracle[i] = desired[i] + (oracle[i] - desired[i]) * exp(-elapsed / tau)
			if desired[i] == Vector2.ZERO and oracle[i].length() <= 0.005:
				oracle[i] = Vector2.ZERO
		oracle_seconds = seconds
		oracle_player = game.player
	expected = desired.duplicate() if valid and disabled else oracle.duplicate()


## Записывает также внутреннюю память: нулевой вывод сам по себе ещё не доказывает корректный следующий шаг.
func _record_sample(
	reset: bool,
	valid: bool,
	desired: PackedVector2Array,
	seconds: float,
	owner: Node,
	motion: Dictionary
) -> void:
	var flag: Variant = game.get_meta(Recovery.FLAG, true)
	var raw := []
	var actual := []
	var filtered := []
	var stored := []
	var seed := []
	for i in 8:
		raw.append(Points.pair(desired[i]))
		actual.append(Points.pair(owner.render_contacts[i]))
		filtered.append(Points.pair(expected[i]))
		stored.append(Points.pair(owner.recovery.entries.get(i, Vector2.ZERO)))
		if pending_seed != Contact.empty():
			seed.append(Points.pair(pending_seed[i]))
	var step := {}
	if not motion.is_empty():
		step = {
			"origin": Points.pair(motion.origin),
			"player": Points.pair(motion.player),
			"delta": motion.delta,
			"world": motion.world,
			"seconds": motion.seconds,
			"velocity": Points.pair(motion.velocity)
		}
	audit.append(
		{
			"reset": reset,
			"valid": valid,
			"seconds": seconds,
			"player": Points.pair(game.player),
			"presented": Points.pair(Contact.Pose.ground(game)),
			"world": game.current_location,
			"mode": mode,
			"flag": flag,
			"visible": owner.visible_rows.duplicate(),
			"seed": seed,
			"stored": stored,
			"raw": raw,
			"actual": actual,
			"expected": filtered,
			"active": owner.recovery.entries.size(),
			"motion": step
		}
	)

	pending_seed = Contact.empty()


## Сравнивает фильтр и технический откат при одном состоянии; после пары возвращает точное исходное состояние фильтра.
func _case(id: String, seconds: float) -> void:
	var owner := game.get_node(Wind.NAME)
	var folder := output.path_join(id)
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(folder)
	_prepare_cpu_meshes(owner, seconds)
	var state := [
		owner.recovery.entries.duplicate(),
		owner.recovery.last_seconds,
		owner.recovery.last_player,
		owner.recovery.last_world
	]
	var original: Variant = game.get_meta(Recovery.FLAG, true)
	var text := JSON.stringify(game.SaveSystem.snapshot(game))
	var si := snapshots.find(text)
	if si < 0:
		si = snapshots.size()
		snapshots.append(text)
	var variants := []
	for active in [true] if mode == "pause" else [true, false]:
		variants.append(await _capture_variant(owner, folder, original, active))

	reference.get_texture().get_image().save_png(folder.path_join("reference.png"))
	var background: Node2D = game.get_node("WorldBackground")
	rows.append(
		{
			"id": id,
			"sample": audit.size() - 1,
			"seconds": seconds,
			"mode": mode,
			"world": game.current_location,
			"player": Points.pair(game.player),
			"camera": Points.pair(game.camera_offset),
			"background":
			{"position": Points.pair(background.position), "scale": Points.pair(background.scale)},
			"snapshot": si,
			"snapshot_sha": text.sha256_text(),
			"window": Points.pair(DisplayServer.window_get_size()),
			"logical": Points.pair(root.get_visible_rect().size),
			"target": Points.pair(owner.batch.viewport.size),
			"visible": root.visible,
			"focused": DisplayServer.window_is_focused(),
			"variants": variants
		}
	)
	game.set_meta(Recovery.FLAG, original)
	owner.recovery.entries = state[0]
	owner.recovery.last_seconds = state[1]
	owner.recovery.last_player = state[2]
	owner.recovery.last_world = state[3]
	Wind.update(game)
	if not root.visible or Points.pair(DisplayServer.window_get_size()) != Points.pair(size):
		errors.append(id + ": invalid window")


## Снимает один вариант и возвращает его паспорт независимо от того, включён фильтр или выключен.
func _capture_variant(owner: Node, folder: String, original: Variant, active: bool) -> Dictionary:
	game.set_meta(Recovery.FLAG, original if active else false)
	Wind.update(game)
	callbacks.clear()
	game.draw_records.clear()
	game.observe_draw = true
	var stats := Wind.statistics(game)
	for frame in 2:
		for group in owner.batch.groups:
			group.queue_redraw()
		game.queue_redraw()
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	game.observe_draw = false
	var label := "on" if active else "off"
	owner.batch.viewport.get_texture().get_image().save_png(folder.path_join(label + ".png"))
	if active:
		root.get_texture().get_image().save_png(folder.path_join("window.png"))
	return {
		"active": active,
		"flag": game.get_meta(Recovery.FLAG),
		"stats": stats,
		"callbacks": callbacks.duplicate(true),
		"draws": _draw_records(),
		"after_sha": JSON.stringify(game.SaveSystem.snapshot(game)).sha256_text()
	}


## Строит независимый CPU-эталон из исходных UV, неподвижной нижней полосы и записанного изгиба.
func _prepare_cpu_meshes(owner: Node, seconds: float) -> void:
	for i in reference_nodes.size():
		var row: Dictionary = owner.batch.rows[i]
		var passport := Wind.Roots.profile(row.kind)
		var data := UV.mesh_data(row.kind, 72.0 / passport.size.x)
		var phase: float = stored_phases[i]
		var amount := (
			Vector2(
				(
					1.35
					* (
						0.78 * sin(seconds * 0.95 + phase)
						+ 0.22 * sin(seconds * 1.61 + phase * 1.7)
					)
				),
				0
			)
			+ expected[i]
		)
		var points: PackedVector2Array = data.arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
		var coords: PackedVector2Array = data.arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV]
		for v in points.size():
			points[v] += (
				amount
				* pow(
					clampf(
						(
							(float(passport.lock_y) / passport.size.y - coords[v].y)
							/ (float(passport.lock_y - passport.top) / passport.size.y)
						),
						0,
						1
					),
					2
				)
			)
		data.arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = points
		reference_nodes[i].mesh = UV.make_mesh(data)
	reference.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE


## Упаковывает фактические обратные вызовы игры, сохраняя снимки до и после рисования.
func _draw_records() -> Array:
	var draws := []
	for r in game.draw_records:
		draws.append(
			{
				"before_sha": JSON.stringify(r.before).sha256_text(),
				"after_sha": JSON.stringify(r.after).sha256_text(),
				"equal": r.equal,
				"geometry_equal": r.geometry_equal,
				"frame": r.process_frame
			}
		)
	return draws

tools/foliage_visibility_capture.gd.before:
extends SceneTree

const Review := preload("res://tests/helpers/foliage_visibility_scenario.gd")
const Observer := preload("res://tools/foliage_visibility_game.gd")
const Budget := preload("res://tools/foliage_visibility_budget.gd")
var output := ""
var profile := ""
var width := 1152
var game: Node
var records := []
var errors := []
var startup := []
var routes := []
var coverage := []
var serial := 0
var presents := 0


## Требует новый output/профиль и настоящий дисплей; никакие headless pixels не становятся GPU-приёмкой.
func _initialize() -> void:
	for arg in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if arg.begins_with("--output="): output = arg.trim_prefix("--output=")
		elif arg.begins_with("--profile="): profile = arg.trim_prefix("--profile=")
		elif arg.begins_with("--width="): width = int(arg.trim_prefix("--width="))
	if output.is_empty() or DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(output) or FileAccess.file_exists(output) or not profile.begins_with("Codex-VFOLIAGE-010-") or width not in [1152, 1280] or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		quit(2)
		return
	ProjectSettings.set_setting("application/config/use_custom_user_dir", true)
	ProjectSettings.set_setting("application/config/custom_user_dir_name", profile)
	if DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(OS.get_user_data_dir()):
		quit(2)
		return
	_run.call_deferred()


## Снимает шесть неизменных маршрутов и крайние bounds; любой отказ прекращает серию с сохранением сырья.
func _run() -> void:
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(output)
	RenderingServer.frame_post_draw.connect(func(): presents += 1)
	Engine.max_fps = 60
	root.title = "VFOLIAGE-010 | visibility and rendering budget"
	if not await _prepare_window():
		errors.append("native window/focus did not settle")
		_write(false)
		quit(1)
		return
	for route in _routes():
		_create_game()
		routes.append(Review.pack(route))
		Review.place(game, route)
		for frame in 36:
			for tick in 2:
				if route.get("camera_only", false):
					Review.Scenario.step(game, Review.DT)
					game.camera_offset = route.camera_start + route.direction * Review.TRAVEL * (frame * 2 + tick + 1) / Review.FRAMES
					Review.Wind.WorldProjection.sync_background(game)
					Review.Wind.update(game)
				else: Review.advance(game, route.direction)
			await _capture(route.id, "full", frame)
			if frame in [0, 17, 35]:
				await _capture(route.id, "culled", frame)
				await _capture(route.id, "unculled", frame)
			if not errors.is_empty(): break
		if not route.get("camera_only", false) and game.player.distance_to(route.start + route.direction * Review.TRAVEL) > 0.01:
			errors.append(route.id + ": actual movement blocked")
		game.free()
		game = null
		_write(false)
		if not errors.is_empty():
			quit(1)
			return
	_create_game()
	for mode in ["normal", "low", "offscreen", "returned"]:
		game.set_meta(Review.Wind.QUALITY, "low" if mode == "low" else "normal")
		game.camera_offset = Vector2(-4000, -4000) if mode == "offscreen" else Review.Wind.placements()[6].anchor - Vector2(480, 270)
		Review.Wind.update(game)
		await _capture("cost", mode, 0)
	game.free()
	game = null
	coverage = await Budget.capture(self, output)
	_write(errors.is_empty())
	print("FOLIAGE VISIBILITY NATIVE: ", records.size(), " frames, ", coverage.size(), " coverage, errors=", errors)
	quit(0 if errors.is_empty() else 1)


## Дожидается устойчивой оконной геометрии и фокуса; каждый probe остаётся в протоколе.
func _prepare_window() -> bool:
	var started := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	var stable := -1
	while Time.get_ticks_msec() - started < 7000:
		root.mode = Window.MODE_WINDOWED
		root.size = Vector2i(width, width * 9 / 16)
		root.show()
		DisplayServer.window_move_to_foreground()
		root.grab_focus()
		await process_frame
		var image := root.get_texture().get_image()
		var ms := Time.get_ticks_msec() - started
		var valid := root.has_focus() and root.mode == Window.MODE_WINDOWED and root.size == Vector2i(width, width * 9 / 16) and image.get_size() == root.size
		startup.append({"ms": ms, "focused": root.has_focus(), "window": Review.pack(root.size), "image": Review.pack(image.get_size()), "windowed": root.mode == Window.MODE_WINDOWED})
		if not valid or ms < 1500: stable = -1
		elif stable < 0: stable = ms
		elif ms - stable >= 500: return true
	return false


## Создаёт обычный overworld; нативный наблюдатель добавляет только маркер и режим изолированного QA-слоя.
func _create_game() -> void:
	game = Review.Scenario.Points.create_game()
	game.set_script(Observer)
	root.add_child(game)
	Review.Scenario.Points.configure(game, Review.Scenario.Points.registry().points[0])
	game.settings_state.reduced_motion = false
	game.set_meta(&"camera_reference_zoom", 1.2)
	game.player = Review.Wind.placements()[6].anchor + Vector2(-12, 0)
	game.update_camera()
	Review.Scenario.Pose.reset(game)
	for index in 12: Review.Scenario.step(game, Review.DT)


## Определяет одни и те же маршруты до съёмки; пустая выборка становится явным отказом.
func _routes() -> Array:
	_create_game()
	var result := Review.routes(game)
	game.free()
	game = null
	if result.size() != 6: errors.append("six predeclared routes unavailable")
	return result


## Ждёт два настоящих present и уникальный16-битный маркер; physics между culling-парой не выполняется.
func _capture(route: String, mode: String, frame: int) -> void:
	serial += 1
	game.review_serial = serial
	game.review_isolated = mode in ["culled", "unculled"]
	game.review_unculled = mode == "unculled"
	game.review_draws.clear()
	var before := Review.Scenario.observe(game)
	var saved: Dictionary = game.SaveSystem.snapshot(game)
	var start := presents
	var first_draw := Engine.get_frames_drawn()
	game.queue_redraw()
	var deadline := Time.get_ticks_msec() + 5000
	while presents < start + 2 and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline: await process_frame
	var image := root.get_texture().get_image()
	image.convert(Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	var marker := 0
	for bit in 16:
		var pixel := image.get_pixel(int((bit * 72 + 36) * width / 1152.0), 2)
		if pixel == Color.WHITE: marker |= 1 << bit
		elif pixel != Color.MAGENTA: errors.append("invalid marker color: " + str(serial))
	if marker != serial or presents < start + 2 or Engine.get_frames_drawn() < first_draw + 2: errors.append("stale native frame: " + str(serial))
	if not root.has_focus() or root.mode != Window.MODE_WINDOWED or image.get_size() != Vector2i(width, width * 9 / 16) or root.size != image.get_size(): errors.append("native window/focus mismatch: " + str(serial))
	if before != Review.Scenario.observe(game) or saved != game.SaveSystem.snapshot(game): errors.append("draw mutated state: " + str(serial))
	var folder := output.path_join(route + "/" + mode)
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(folder)
	var relative := route + "/" + mode + "/%03d.png" % frame
	if image.save_png(output.path_join(relative)) != OK: errors.append("cannot save " + relative)
	var hash := HashingContext.new()
	hash.start(HashingContext.HASH_SHA256)
	hash.update(image.get_data())
	records.append({"route": route, "mode": mode, "index": frame, "serial": serial, "image": relative, "rgba_sha256": hash.finish().hex_encode(), "focused": root.has_focus(), "windowed": root.mode == Window.MODE_WINDOWED, "size": Review.pack(image.get_size()), "presents": presents - start, "drawn_frames": Engine.get_frames_drawn() - first_draw, "draws": game.review_draws.duplicate(true), "state": Review.pack(before), "save_sha256": JSON.stringify(saved, "", true, true).sha256_text(), "budget": Budget.observe(game)})


## Сохраняет также неполный запуск; complete никогда не выставляется при ошибках.
func _write(complete: bool) -> void:
	FileAccess.open(output.path_join("capture.json"), FileAccess.WRITE).store_string(JSON.stringify({"task": "VFOLIAGE-010", "complete": complete, "profile": profile, "width": width, "display": DisplayServer.get_name(), "engine": Engine.get_version_info(), "startup": startup, "routes": routes, "records": records, "coverage": coverage, "errors": errors}, "  ") + "\n")

## Снимает шесть неизменных маршрутов и крайние bounds; любой отказ прекращает серию с сохранением сырья.
func _run() -> void:
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(output)
	RenderingServer.frame_post_draw.connect(func(): presents += 1)
	Engine.max_fps = 60
	root.title = "VFOLIAGE-010 | visibility and rendering budget"
	if not await _prepare_window():
		errors.append("native window/focus did not settle")
		_write(false)
		quit(1)
		return
	for route in _routes():
		_create_game()
		routes.append(Review.pack(route))
		Review.place(game, route)
		for frame in 36:
			for tick in 2:
				if route.get("camera_only", false):
					Review.Scenario.step(game, Review.DT)
					game.camera_offset = route.camera_start + route.direction * Review.TRAVEL * (frame * 2 + tick + 1) / Review.FRAMES
					Review.Wind.WorldProjection.sync_background(game)
					Review.Wind.update(game)
				else: Review.advance(game, route.direction)
			await _capture(route.id, "full", frame)
			if frame in [0, 17, 35]:
				await _capture(route.id, "culled", frame)
				await _capture(route.id, "unculled", frame)
			if not errors.is_empty(): break
		if not route.get("camera_only", false) and game.player.distance_to(route.start + route.direction * Review.TRAVEL) > 0.01:
			errors.append(route.id + ": actual movement blocked")
		game.free()
		game = null
		_write(false)
		if not errors.is_empty():
			quit(1)
			return
	_create_game()
	for mode in ["normal", "low", "offscreen", "returned"]:
		game.set_meta(Review.Wind.QUALITY, "low" if mode == "low" else "normal")
		game.camera_offset = Vector2(-4000, -4000) if mode == "offscreen" else Review.Wind.placements()[6].anchor - Vector2(480, 270)
		Review.Wind.update(game)
		await _capture("cost", mode, 0)
	game.free()
	game = null
	coverage = await Budget.capture(self, output)
	_write(errors.is_empty())
	print("FOLIAGE VISIBILITY NATIVE: ", records.size(), " frames, ", coverage.size(), " coverage, errors=", errors)
	quit(0 if errors.is_empty() else 1)


## Дожидается устойчивой оконной геометрии и фокуса; каждый probe остаётся в протоколе.
func _prepare_window() -> bool:
	var started := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	var stable := -1
	while Time.get_ticks_msec() - started < 7000:
		root.mode = Window.MODE_WINDOWED
		root.size = Vector2i(width, width * 9 / 16)
		root.show()
		DisplayServer.window_move_to_foreground()
		root.grab_focus()
		await process_frame
		var image := root.get_texture().get_image()
		var ms := Time.get_ticks_msec() - started
		var valid := root.has_focus() and root.mode == Window.MODE_WINDOWED and root.size == Vector2i(width, width * 9 / 16) and image.get_size() == root.size
		startup.append({"ms": ms, "focused": root.has_focus(), "window": Review.pack(root.size), "image": Review.pack(image.get_size()), "windowed": root.mode == Window.MODE_WINDOWED})
		if not valid or ms < 1500: stable = -1
		elif stable < 0: stable = ms
		elif ms - stable >= 500: return true
	return false


## Создаёт обычный overworld; нативный наблюдатель добавляет только маркер и режим изолированного QA-слоя.
func _create_game() -> void:
	game = Review.Scenario.Points.create_game()
	game.set_script(Observer)
	root.add_child(game)
	Review.Scenario.Points.configure(game, Review.Scenario.Points.registry().points[0])
	game.settings_state.reduced_motion = false
	game.set_meta(&"camera_reference_zoom", 1.2)
	game.player = Review.Wind.placements()[6].anchor + Vector2(-12, 0)
	game.update_camera()
	Review.Scenario.Pose.reset(game)
	for index in 12: Review.Scenario.step(game, Review.DT)


## Определяет одни и те же маршруты до съёмки; пустая выборка становится явным отказом.
func _routes() -> Array:
	_create_game()
	var result := Review.routes(game)
	game.free()
	game = null
	if result.size() != 6: errors.append("six predeclared routes unavailable")
	return result


## Ждёт два настоящих present и уникальный16-битный маркер; physics между culling-парой не выполняется.
func _capture(route: String, mode: String, frame: int) -> void:
	serial += 1
	game.review_serial = serial
	game.review_isolated = mode in ["culled", "unculled"]
	game.review_unculled = mode == "unculled"
	game.review_draws.clear()
	var before := Review.Scenario.observe(game)
	var saved: Dictionary = game.SaveSystem.snapshot(game)
	var start := presents
	var first_draw := Engine.get_frames_drawn()
	game.queue_redraw()
	var deadline := Time.get_ticks_msec() + 5000
	while presents < start + 2 and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline: await process_frame
	var image := root.get_texture().get_image()
	image.convert(Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	var marker := 0
	for bit in 16:
		var pixel := image.get_pixel(int((bit * 72 + 36) * width / 1152.0), 2)
		if pixel == Color.WHITE: marker |= 1 << bit
		elif pixel != Color.MAGENTA: errors.append("invalid marker color: " + str(serial))
	if marker != serial or presents < start + 2 or Engine.get_frames_drawn() < first_draw + 2: errors.append("stale native frame: " + str(serial))
	if not root.has_focus() or root.mode != Window.MODE_WINDOWED or image.get_size() != Vector2i(width, width * 9 / 16) or root.size != image.get_size(): errors.append("native window/focus mismatch: " + str(serial))
	if before != Review.Scenario.observe(game) or saved != game.SaveSystem.snapshot(game): errors.append("draw mutated state: " + str(serial))
	var folder := output.path_join(route + "/" + mode)
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(folder)
	var relative := route + "/" + mode + "/%03d.png" % frame
	if image.save_png(output.path_join(relative)) != OK: errors.append("cannot save " + relative)
	var hash := HashingContext.new()
	hash.start(HashingContext.HASH_SHA256)
	hash.update(image.get_data())
	records.append({"route": route, "mode": mode, "index": frame, "serial": serial, "image": relative, "rgba_sha256": hash.finish().hex_encode(), "focused": root.has_focus(), "windowed": root.mode == Window.MODE_WINDOWED, "size": Review.pack(image.get_size()), "presents": presents - start, "drawn_frames": Engine.get_frames_drawn() - first_draw, "draws": game.review_draws.duplicate(true), "state": Review.pack(before), "save_sha256": JSON.stringify(saved, "", true, true).sha256_text(), "budget": Budget.observe(game)})


## Сохраняет также неполный запуск; complete никогда не выставляется при ошибках.
func _write(complete: bool) -> void:
	FileAccess.open(output.path_join("capture.json"), FileAccess.WRITE).store_string(JSON.stringify({"task": "VFOLIAGE-010", "complete": complete, "profile": profile, "width": width, "display": DisplayServer.get_name(), "engine": Engine.get_version_info(), "startup": startup, "routes": routes, "records": records, "coverage": coverage, "errors": errors}, "  ") + "\n")

extends SceneTree

const Points := preload("res://tools/visual_camera_points.gd")
const Rules := preload("res://scripts/presentation/village_decoration_rules.gd")
const Map := preload("res://scripts/systems/village_map_data.gd")
var folder := ""
var profile := ""
var size := Vector2i(1152,648)
var game: Node
var bg: Node
var overlay: Node2D
var rows := []
var errors := []

## Требует настоящее окно, новый каталог и отдельный QA-профиль.
func _initialize() -> void:
	for arg in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if arg.begins_with("--output="): folder=arg.trim_prefix("--output=")
		elif arg.begins_with("--profile="): profile=arg.trim_prefix("--profile=")
		elif arg=="--wide": size=Vector2i(1280,720)
	if folder.is_empty() or not profile.begins_with("Codex-VGROUND-008-") or "/" in profile or "\\" in profile:
		push_error("Fresh isolated output/profile required"); quit(2); return
	ProjectSettings.set_setting("application/config/use_custom_user_dir",true)
	ProjectSettings.set_setting("application/config/custom_user_dir_name",profile)
	_start.call_deferred()

## Сравнивает штатную сцену и явно обозначенный запасной посев, не создавая новых игровых цветов.
func _start() -> void:
	if DisplayServer.get_name()=="headless" or DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(folder) or not OS.get_user_data_dir().ends_with(profile) or FileAccess.file_exists("user://farm-settings.cfg"):
		push_error("Native display and unused isolated paths required"); quit(2); return
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(folder)
	game=Points.create_game(); game.set_script(preload("res://tools/render_order_game.gd")); root.add_child(game); current_scene=game
	Points.configure(game,Points.registry().points[0])
	preload("res://scripts/systems/world_projection_system.gd").set_reference_zoom(game,1.2)
	bg=game.get_node("WorldBackground"); overlay=preload("res://tools/qa/ground/decoration_overlay.gd").new(); bg.add_child(overlay)
	root.title="VGROUND-008 | decoration exclusions (diagnostic fallback)"
	await _settle(1000); root.mode=Window.MODE_WINDOWED; await _settle(800); root.size=size; root.show(); root.grab_focus(); await _settle(800)
	for attempt in 15:
		if root.mode==Window.MODE_WINDOWED and DisplayServer.window_get_size()==size: break
		root.mode=Window.MODE_WINDOWED; root.size=size; await _settle(200)
	if root.mode!=Window.MODE_WINDOWED or DisplayServer.window_get_size()!=size:
		push_error("Native size did not settle"); quit(2); return
	for entry in [
		["cottage",Vector2(360,648),1,"clear"],["services",Vector2(1392,624),1,"clear"],
		["farm",Vector2(456,984),1,"clear"],["bridge-west",Map.BRIDGES[0].get_center(),1,"clear"],
		["bridge-east",Map.BRIDGES[1].get_center(),1,"clear"],["road-turn",Vector2(2016,744),1,"clear"],
		["road-end",Vector2(1704,864),1,"clear"],["summer",Vector2(360,648),8,"clear"],
		["autumn",Vector2(360,648),15,"clear"],["winter",Vector2(360,648),22,"clear"],
		["rain",Vector2(360,648),1,"rain"]]:
		game.day=entry[2]; game.state.world.weather_day=game.day; game.state.world.weather=entry[3]
		bg.set_environment(game.WorldEventSystem.season(game.day),entry[3]); await _case(entry[0],entry[1])
	game.state.world.weather="clear"; bg.set_environment("spring","clear")
	if not game.BuildingSystem.enter(game,"cottage"): errors.append("house entry failed")
	await _case("interior",game.player)
	if not game.BuildingSystem.leave(game): errors.append("house exit failed")
	await _case("returned",Vector2(360,648))
	await _board(false); await _board(true)
	var zones:=[]; var candidates:=[]; var plan:=Rules.legacy_plan()
	for zone in Rules.exclusions(): zones.append({"id":zone.id,"reason":zone.reason,"rect":_rect(zone.rect)})
	for row in Rules.legacy_candidates(): candidates.append({"position":Points.pair(row.position),"rect":_rect(row.rect),"reason":Rules.reason(row.rect)})
	_write("policy.json",{"margin":Rules.MARGIN,"limit":Rules.LIMIT,"world":Points.pair(Map.WORLD_SIZE),"zones":zones,"candidates":candidates,
		"water":[Array(Map.river_polygon()).map(func(p:Vector2): return Points.pair(p)),Array(Map.pond_polygon()).map(func(p:Vector2): return Points.pair(p))],
		"accepted":plan.accepted.size(),"rejected":plan.rejected.size()})
	_write("capture.json",{"task":"VGROUND-008","profile":profile,"window":Points.pair(size),"display":DisplayServer.get_name(),
		"engine":Engine.get_version_info().string,"rows":rows,"errors":errors,"simulation_frozen":true,"performance_eligible":false,"gpu_time_ms":null,
		"ordinary_scene_has_procedural_seed":false,"diagnostic_overlay_only":true,"rain_pixel_equality_not_claimed":true})
	quit(0 if errors.is_empty() else 2)

## Возвращает исходное состояние вокруг старого и отфильтрованного диагностического слоя.
func _case(id: String, player: Vector2) -> void:
	game.player=player; game.facing=Vector2.DOWN; game.update_camera(); preload("res://scripts/systems/presentation_pose_system.gd").reset(game)
	for mode in ["control-before","before","after","control-after"]:
		overlay.visible=mode in ["before","after"] and game.current_location=="overworld"
		overlay.guarded=mode=="after"; overlay.queue_redraw(); bg.queue_redraw(); await _settle(150)
		await _shot(id+"-"+mode,mode)

## Записывает настоящий кадр с полными состояниями вокруг четырёх штатных draw.
func _shot(id: String, mode: String) -> void:
	game.message=""; game.observe_draw=false; await _redraw(4)
	game.draw_records.clear(); game.observe_draw=true; await _redraw(4); game.observe_draw=false
	var image:=root.get_texture().get_image(); image.save_png(folder.path_join(id+".png")); _write(id+"-draws.json",game.draw_records)
	if image.get_size()!=size or DisplayServer.window_get_size()!=size or not DisplayServer.window_is_focused(): errors.append(id+": size/focus changed")
	rows.append({"id":id,"mode":mode,"readback":Points.pair(image.get_size()),"logical":Points.pair(root.get_visible_rect().size),
		"camera":Points.pair(game.camera_offset),"player":Points.pair(game.player),"location":game.current_location,"season":bg.season,"weather":bg.weather,
		"draws":game.draw_records.size(),"snapshot":game.SaveSystem.snapshot(game),"focused":DisplayServer.window_is_focused(),
		"physical":Points.pair(DisplayServer.window_get_size()),"zoom":game.get_meta(&"camera_reference_zoom"),"diagnostic":overlay.visible})
	print("DECORATION SHOT ",id)

## Сохраняет прозрачный лист реальных травинок в полном мировом масштабе, без отдаления скриншота.
func _board(guarded: bool) -> void:
	var view:=SubViewport.new(); view.size=Vector2i(Map.WORLD_SIZE); view.disable_3d=true; view.transparent_bg=true; view.render_target_update_mode=SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
	var board:=preload("res://tools/qa/ground/decoration_overlay.gd").new(); board.guarded=guarded; root.add_child(view); view.add_child(board)
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	view.get_texture().get_image().save_png(folder.path_join("seed-"+("after" if guarded else "before")+".png"))
	view.queue_free(); await process_frame

## Ждёт реальные callbacks при остановленной симуляции; это не замер FPS.
func _redraw(count: int) -> void:
	for i in count: game.queue_redraw(); await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw

## Позволяет оконному серверу закончить размещение и перерисовку.
func _settle(ms: int) -> void:
	var deadline:=Time.get_ticks_msec()+ms
	while Time.get_ticks_msec()<deadline: game.queue_redraw(); await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw

## Переводит геометрию в числовые пары для независимой проверки.
func _rect(rect: Rect2) -> Array:
	return [rect.position.x,rect.position.y,rect.size.x,rect.size.y]

## Пишет только в свежий каталог доказательств.
func _write(name: String, value: Variant) -> void:
	FileAccess.open(folder.path_join(name),FileAccess.WRITE).store_string(JSON.stringify(value)+"\n")

		["road-end",Vector2(1704,864),1,"clear"],["summer",Vector2(360,648),8,"clear"],
		["autumn",Vector2(360,648),15,"clear"],["winter",Vector2(360,648),22,"clear"],
		["rain",Vector2(360,648),1,"rain"]]:
		game.day=entry[2]; game.state.world.weather_day=game.day; game.state.world.weather=entry[3]
		bg.set_environment(game.WorldEventSystem.season(game.day),entry[3]); await _case(entry[0],entry[1])
	game.state.world.weather="clear"; bg.set_environment("spring","clear")
	if not game.BuildingSystem.enter(game,"cottage"): errors.append("house entry failed")
	await _case("interior",game.player)
	if not game.BuildingSystem.leave(game): errors.append("house exit failed")
	await _case("returned",Vector2(360,648))
	await _board(false); await _board(true)
	var zones:=[]; var candidates:=[]; var plan:=Rules.legacy_plan()
	for zone in Rules.exclusions(): zones.append({"id":zone.id,"reason":zone.reason,"rect":_rect(zone.rect)})
	for row in Rules.legacy_candidates(): candidates.append({"position":Points.pair(row.position),"rect":_rect(row.rect),"reason":Rules.reason(row.rect)})
	_write("policy.json",{"margin":Rules.MARGIN,"limit":Rules.LIMIT,"world":Points.pair(Map.WORLD_SIZE),"zones":zones,"candidates":candidates,
		"water":[Array(Map.river_polygon()).map(func(p:Vector2): return Points.pair(p)),Array(Map.pond_polygon()).map(func(p:Vector2): return Points.pair(p))],
		"accepted":plan.accepted.size(),"rejected":plan.rejected.size()})
	_write("capture.json",{"task":"VGROUND-008","profile":profile,"window":Points.pair(size),"display":DisplayServer.get_name(),
		"engine":Engine.get_version_info().string,"rows":rows,"errors":errors,"simulation_frozen":true,"performance_eligible":false,"gpu_time_ms":null,
		"ordinary_scene_has_procedural_seed":false,"diagnostic_overlay_only":true,"rain_pixel_equality_not_claimed":true})
	quit(0 if errors.is_empty() else 2)

## Возвращает исходное состояние вокруг старого и отфильтрованного диагностического слоя.
func _case(id: String, player: Vector2) -> void:
	game.player=player; game.facing=Vector2.DOWN; game.update_camera(); preload("res://scripts/systems/presentation_pose_system.gd").reset(game)
	for mode in ["control-before","before","after","control-after"]:
		overlay.visible=mode in ["before","after"] and game.current_location=="overworld"
		overlay.guarded=mode=="after"; overlay.queue_redraw(); bg.queue_redraw(); await _settle(150)
		await _shot(id+"-"+mode,mode)

## Записывает настоящий кадр с полными состояниями вокруг четырёх штатных draw.
func _shot(id: String, mode: String) -> void:
	game.message=""; game.observe_draw=false; await _redraw(4)
	game.draw_records.clear(); game.observe_draw=true; await _redraw(4); game.observe_draw=false
	var image:=root.get_texture().get_image(); image.save_png(folder.path_join(id+".png")); _write(id+"-draws.json",game.draw_records)
	if image.get_size()!=size or DisplayServer.window_get_size()!=size or not DisplayServer.window_is_focused(): errors.append(id+": size/focus changed")
	rows.append({"id":id,"mode":mode,"readback":Points.pair(image.get_size()),"logical":Points.pair(root.get_visible_rect().size),
		"camera":Points.pair(game.camera_offset),"player":Points.pair(game.player),"location":game.current_location,"season":bg.season,"weather":bg.weather,
		"draws":game.draw_records.size(),"snapshot":game.SaveSystem.snapshot(game),"focused":DisplayServer.window_is_focused(),
		"physical":Points.pair(DisplayServer.window_get_size()),"zoom":game.get_meta(&"camera_reference_zoom"),"diagnostic":overlay.visible})
	print("DECORATION SHOT ",id)

## Сохраняет прозрачный лист реальных травинок в полном мировом масштабе, без отдаления скриншота.
func _board(guarded: bool) -> void:
	var view:=SubViewport.new(); view.size=Vector2i(Map.WORLD_SIZE); view.disable_3d=true; view.transparent_bg=true; view.render_target_update_mode=SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
	var board:=preload("res://tools/qa/ground/decoration_overlay.gd").new(); board.guarded=guarded; root.add_child(view); view.add_child(board)
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	view.get_texture().get_image().save_png(folder.path_join("seed-"+("after" if guarded else "before")+".png"))
	view.queue_free(); await process_frame

## Ждёт реальные callbacks при остановленной симуляции; это не замер FPS.
func _redraw(count: int) -> void:
	for i in count: game.queue_redraw(); await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw

## Позволяет оконному серверу закончить размещение и перерисовку.
func _settle(ms: int) -> void:
	var deadline:=Time.get_ticks_msec()+ms
	while Time.get_ticks_msec()<deadline: game.queue_redraw(); await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw

## Переводит геометрию в числовые пары для независимой проверки.
func _rect(rect: Rect2) -> Array:
	return [rect.position.x,rect.position.y,rect.size.x,rect.size.y]

## Пишет только в свежий каталог доказательств.
func _write(name: String, value: Variant) -> void:
	FileAccess.open(folder.path_join(name),FileAccess.WRITE).store_string(JSON.stringify(value)+"\n")
